name: backseat-driver-dev
description: Development tooling for the Backseat Driver plugin. Nothing here ships to users: the plugin is the plugin/ folder. TypeScript checks the types. license-server/ is a reference license server, also never shipped. spago and esbuild build the PureScript kernel into plugin/core/kernel.js, and the compiler itself comes by pinned hash (scripts/toolchain.py).

scripts.validate: claude plugin validate . --strict && claude plugin validate ./plugin --strict
scripts.licenses: cmp LICENSE plugin/LICENSE && cmp COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md plugin/COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md
scripts.check: npm run kernel && npm run validate && npm run licenses && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run core && npm run server && npm run tools
